description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Aluth Wewa, Welikanda D/S Division, Polonnaruwa District (25/1200076)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically calling for claims to land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land ownership determinations, cadastral maps, and title settlement procedures in various villages of Polonnaruwa District, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related administrative matters.
